Interpretation¶

Machine Learning Model¶

The applied model was Linear Regression and here are the below points:

1. Genom 
2. Line plot 
3. Scatter

The Linear Regression model was used to predict Sales using Amount, Gas Fee USD, and Daily Revenue USD. The negative R² value (-0.0025) indicates poor model performance. The high MAE and RMSE suggest large prediction errors, likely due to extreme values or outliers in Sales.

Amount and Gas Fee show a positive relationship with Sales, while Daily Revenue shows a negative relationship. Overall, the model does not effectively predict Sales, and further data cleaning may improve its performance.
